fields.description: Debit account of the fee Journal Entry for NovaPay, MegaMega, and MAIB Ecomm. The MAIB POS register does not create that Journal Entry.
fields.label: Fee Account

fields.description: Deposit Bank Transactions are searched on this account. MAIB POS also searches fee withdrawals here.
fields.label: Bank Account

fields.description: Payouts are linked only when the Bank Transaction party is this supplier. MAIB POS fee withdrawals use the same supplier.
fields.label: Supplier

fields.description: Text that must appear in the payout description. Choosing a source fills the default for that source.
fields.label: Deposit Description

fields.description: When set, payment search matches Payment Entries with this mode. MAIB POS also matches POS invoices paid with this mode. The card payment posts to the clearing account. The bank credit moves that amount from clearing to the bank account.
fields.label: Mode of Payment

fields.description: Written onto a payment row that has no customer. While the row has no Payment Entry or Sales Invoice, it can be changed or cleared. A selected customer limits the payment and invoice lists and is not replaced.
fields.label: Default Customer

fields.description: Shows Identify Payment Documents in the Actions menu.
fields.label: Search Posted Payments

fields.description: Submit does not create a Payment Entry. On a submitted register this shows Create Missing Payments in the Actions menu. That item creates one Payment Entry for a row that still has no link and already has a customer, a payment amount, and a clearing account. A linked row is left as it is. Leave this off for MAIB POS until the invoice stores ReferintaTranzactiei.
fields.label: Create Payment If Missing
